Allah swears by the morning brightness.
And by the night when it becomes still and dark.
Your Lord has not left you, and He does not hate you.
And the next life is better for you than this one.
And your Lord will soon give you so much that you will be pleased.
Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?
And find you lost and guide you?
And find you poor and make you content?
So do not be harsh to the orphan.
And do not scold the one who asks for help.
And talk about the blessings of your Lord.
